title: Champ Client · server rules
intro: By staying in this server you agree to the rules below. They apply in every channel, in DMs between members, and in voice.
footer: Breaking a rule can lead to a mute, kick or ban without warning. Appeals go through a ticket.

sections.title: 01 · Respect everyone
sections.body: No harassment, hate speech, threats, doxxing or personal attacks. Disagreements about a client or a fight stay about the game.

sections.title: 02 · No scams or fake downloads
sections.body: Never post cracked builds, reuploads, license keys or "free" download links. Champ is only distributed through the official site and this server.

sections.title: 03 · Keep private things private
sections.body: Do not share DMs, tickets, logs, order details or any personal information without permission from everyone involved.

sections.title: 04 · Support goes through tickets
sections.body: Open a ticket for bugs, billing and license issues so staff can actually find it. Do not DM staff for support unless they ask you to.

sections.title: 05 · No advertising or DM spam
sections.body: Invites, other clients, shops and services need staff approval first. Mass DMs, mention spam and copy-paste ads are not allowed.

sections.title: 06 · No chargebacks
sections.body: If something is wrong with an order, open a ticket first. A chargeback without contact ends the license and the account.

sections.title: 07 · One account, no ban evasion
sections.body: Do not use alt accounts to get around a mute, kick or ban. Appeals are handled in a ticket, not with a new account.

sections.title: 08 · Keep it legal and clean
sections.body: No NSFW, gore, piracy or illegal content. English or Dutch in public channels so staff can moderate.
